summary: Frontend-only testing of new Ääniasetukset (voice settings) modal. All 7 review scenarios pass: gear button present in header, modal opens with GB highlighted by default, clicking accent-us persists accent='us' to localStorage 'ket_voice_v1', rate slider updates readout (e.g. '1.10×') and persists rate, test-voice-button click does not crash, close button and backdrop click both close the modal, click inside white modal does not close it, persisted values are shown on reopen. Regression: topic menu still loads and gear remains visible/functional on all screens.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsModal.chooseAccent() calls speak('Hello') on every accent click — may be surprising UX if user is toggling; consider only speaking on the explicit 'Kokeile ääntä' button.

getVoiceSettings() spreads DEFAULT_VOICE first then parsed JSON — good; but no validation that stored rate is within 0.5–1.3 range (speak() clamps to 0.5–1.5 which is fine, but slider min/max differs from clamp).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SettingsModal fully verified via headless Playwright against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. localStorage key 'ket_voice_v1' correctly stores {accent, rate}. Audio playback is silent in headless (expected).
